# Ferropericlase B1: EOS reconstruction reports

<!-- Generated by scripts.generate_reconstruction_reports; edit EOSMAT instead. -->

[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/mg090fe010o.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/mg090fe010o.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/mg090fe010o.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

<a id="record-mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1"></a>

## Solomatova et al. (2016), hs BM3 reference branch

**close** · `mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mg090fe010o.md#record-mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets either the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison or parameter-specific numerical similarity screen; the audit does not classify the complete comparison as parity.

- Coupled three-level spin-state reconstruction using the recovered earlier observations and Solomatova Table 2 priors. The original MINUTI input, row weights, residual definition, and covariance are unpublished, so this equal-weight approximate-volume fit tests numerical similarity rather than claiming an exact reproduction.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** mg090fe010o\_marquardt\_2009\_table2\_pv
- **Observations:** 29
- **Fit kind:** coupled\_bm3\_three\_level\_spin\_crossover
- **Selection:** used\_in\_solomatova\_2016\_fit=1
- **Objective:** equal-weight approximate volume residuals plus Table 2 priors
- **Free parameters:** V0\_HS; K0\_HS; K0\_prime\_HS; V0\_LS; K0\_LS; omega0
- **Fixed parameters:** None declared

### Curves and residuals

![Source and refit curves with native-coordinate residuals for mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1](figures/mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1-curves.svg#only-light)
![Source and refit curves with native-coordinate residuals for mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1](figures/mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Output / replay scope | Points | Residual units | Source RMS | Refit RMS |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| Coupled three-level spin-crossover trajectory | 29 | GPa | 0.839 | 0.7 |

The plotted curve is the complete coupled mixed-spin trajectory; this record's coefficient table describes one HS/LS reference endmember. The source-constrained diagnostic uses both Table 7 endmembers and the Table 2 midpoint. The refit's internal omega0, omitted from the ledger, is recovered algebraically from both stored endmembers and its stored 50% transition pressure. No optimizer is run. Vertical pressure RMS is descriptive; the original audit minimized approximate volume residuals plus priors, and exact MINUTI weights/workflow remain unknown.

### Coefficients

![Source/target and reconstructed central values for mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1](figures/mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1.svg#only-light)
![Source/target and reconstructed central values for mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1](figures/mg090fe010o_solomatova_2016_hs_bm3_reference_1-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Parameter | Source / target | Source error | Reconstruction | Reconstruction error | Fit role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| V0 | 75.55 | 0.04 | 75.3435 | Not reported | See protocol |
| K0 | 159.0 | 2.0 | 161.471 | Not reported | See protocol |
| K0\_prime | 3.96 | 0.14 | 4.06269 | Not reported | See protocol |

<summary>Recorded diagnostics, covariance and additional protocol</summary>

- **Solver success:** True
- **Solver message:** dedicated Solomatova coupled reconstruction completed
- **Rmse volume a3:** 0.15387

</details>

## Marquardt et al. (2009), EPSL LS BM3 Table S1 row 1

**reproduced** · `mg090fe010o_marquardt_2009b_ls_bm3_s1_01` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/mg090fe010o.md#record-mg090fe010o_marquardt_2009b_ls_bm3_s1_01)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Conditional numerical agreement within reported source error widths where available, and explicitly verified half-last-digit printing tolerances otherwise. Printing precision is not a standard error or confidence interval; fixed constraints and source-equation versus independent-data scope remain explicit.

- Every compared free coefficient meets its printed source error width or the explicitly verified half-last-digit tolerance where source errors are absent. Printing precision is not a confidence interval. Table S1 prints K0 as integer GPa: half-last-digit tolerance is 0.5 GPa, not an invented standard error. Only K0 is varied in the existing six-row cold LS fit, with each source V0/K0-prime fixed. No fit is preferred; uncertainty, exact source weighting and spin-mixture reproduction remain unestablished. Source tokens: peritheos/data/datasets/mg090fe010o-marquardt-2009-table-s1-ls-models.csv. Earlier audit wording (superseded only for the named numerical scope): One of 12 alternative constrained LS fits from EPSL Table S1. Source objective weights and coefficient standard errors are not reported; the refit errors are residual-scaled diagnostics, not published uncertainties.

- **Free parameters:** K0
